scientific_integrity: The analytic reduction and exact rational finite enumeration establish the stated constants; random tests are supplementary. Same-model scientific review only, no independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness and Lipschitz estimates concern only nonnegative real signals on unweighted ordinary cycles C3, C4 and C5 with unweighted undirected edge variation; no result is asserted for signed-input absolute-value maps, larger graphs, nonuniform masses, or weighted variations. Historical-priority uncertainty remains. All finite certificates are reproducible by the accompanying standard-library script.
title: Sharp two-input variation sensitivity of centered maximal averaging on the smallest cycles
